one_liner: Discord API and developer platform for building bots, applications, and integrations.
access_notes: Developers can create an application and get bot credentials self-serve for free through the Discord Developer Portal.
verdict_reason: Discord provides extensive free, self-serve APIs and documentation for building applications and bots.

evidence.snippet: Using a bot token found on the Bot page within your app’s settings.
Using an OAuth2 bearer token gained through the OAuth2 API.
Using basic authentication with credentials as the client ID and client secret found on the OAuth2 page
You create an application in the Discord Developer Portal, add a bot, copy its token and invite it with OAuth2 scopes. No paid plan is required
Discord does not publish an official MCP server yet, so teams run community-built servers on top of the Discord API.
